job.question: In the Massachusetts PRIM Board's September 2026 RFP for Active Global Core Equity investment management services, what minimum total firm assets under management must a respondent have?
job.expected_facts: At least $5 billion in total firm assets under management as of June 30, 2026.
job.acceptance: At least $5bn total firm AUM as of June 30, 2026. Do not confuse firm AUM with product assets.

reviews.reason: This is an Oklahoma OPERS RFP issued in July 2023 for passive index management, not the Massachusetts PRIM Board’s September 2026 Active Global Core Equity RFP. Its firm-wide AUM requirement is $10 billion as of June 30, 2023, so it does not support the requested threshold or date.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-24-001 U.S. EQUITY, Non-U.S. EQUITY, AND FIXED INCOME (TIPS) INDEX INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES
OPERS RFP – Investment Management Services – Issued July 20, 2023 Page 1 of 17
The proposed investment management firm must have assets under management (firm-wide) of at least $10 billion as of June 30, 2023.
